meta.title: Email Announcement — Half a Camel November Comedy Extravaganza

claim_summary: Half a Camel Productions independently announced and operated the November 2024 Comedy Extravaganza across four Brighton venues, proving continuity beyond Brighton Fringe and contradicting later erasure narratives.
key_points: Announcement explicitly states the event is independent of Brighton Fringe.
Four venues managed: Caxton Arms, Joker, 3 Jolly Butchers, Comedy on the Bleach.
Registration run via Eventotron; no box office cut taken.
First 20 acts offered free registration — proof of community-support model.
Drive folder with venue photos/spreadsheets linked as corroborating material.

contradictions.claim: Brighton Fringe later denied Half a Camel ran independent events.
impact: Contradicts public record of independent promotion.

contradictions.claim: Fringe benefitted from HAC’s venues in May 2024 but erased the Nov 2024 expansion.

timeline_hooks.note: Launch email circulated to acts announcing Nov 2024 Comedy Extravaganza.
Two-week run of shows across four Brighton venues.
